metric_definitions.invariance_rate: Fraction of BLOSUM62-conservative (P2) perturbations with |delta score| <= threshold.
metric_definitions.false_sensitivity_rate: Fraction of P2 perturbations that flip the predicted class label despite being conservative.
metric_definitions.redox_sensitivity_rate: Fraction of alanine scans (P1) at redox residues that reduce the score by more than threshold (higher is mechanistically better, not part of BCS).
